steps: Extend the two sides through the central corner into full perpendicular lines.
A 90° rotation about the fixed square's center maps the square to itself and each of the four sectors to the next. All four pieces have equal area.
Every point in the fixed square is at most 10/√2 cm from its center, less than 10 cm. The tilted square's far sides cannot cut off any of its sector.
The overlap is one of the four equal pieces: 10²/4 = 25 cm², regardless of the rotation.
